carpet.rule.fullrangecfinditem.desc: Allows all players to use the full-range /cfinditem search
carpet.rule.fullrangecfinditem.extra.0: Searches containers in loaded chunks within render distance without opening them. Only ClientCommands is required on the client; this addon and Carpet are only required on the server.
carpet.rule.fullrangecfinditem.extra.1: Advertises level-2 permissions to clients without granting server permissions. Other client features that check this permission indicator may also become available.
carpet.rule.ghostProjectileFix.extra.0: overrides ghostEntitiesFix (the general fix for all entities) for projectiles
